Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles These Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles are an easy, flavorful dinner. This is a quick dinner the whole family will love! Thank you for the inspo @britscookin 🫶 Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 4 packages ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded (about 10–12 oz) Salt and black pepper, to taste 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 1 head broccoli, cut into florets 1/3 cup water, for steaming broccoli Mongolian Sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/3 cup brown sugar 2 tbsp hoisin sauce 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp fresh ginger paste  1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, optional Cornstarch Slurry 1 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp cold water Directions 1. Add the ground beef to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain any excess grease if needed. 2. Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the skillet.  3. Add 1/3 of water to the skillet and cover to let the broccoli steam for a few minutes.  4. While the broccoli is steaming, cook the ramen noodles according to the package directions, leaving out the seasoning packets. Drain and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. 6. Pour the Mongolian sauce over the beef, mushrooms, and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water. Pour the slurry into the skillet and let everything simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Add the cooked ramen noodles and toss until everything is coated in the sauce. #EasyRecipe #DinnerIdeas #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #easydinner

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

One pot chicken fajita rice skillet smothered in queso 🤤 The easiest weeknight dinner and one of those recipes the whole family will love. Save this one for your next easy dinner! One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Raspberry cheesecake donuts ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Raspberry jam - 300g raspberries (about 2 cups) - 225g granulated sugar (1 cup + 2 tbsp) - Juice of 1/2 lemon - Cornstarch slurry Cheesecake filling - 5 oz cream cheese, softened  - 250g powdered sugar (2 cups) - 57g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 45g heavy cream (3 tbsp) - 2 tsp vanilla extract - 1 dolop of raspberry jam - 1/4 tsp salt  Raspberry sugar  - 15g freeze dried raspberries, blended (about 1 cup) - 120g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) Instructions  - In a large bowl, bloom the yeast with 1 tbsp honey in the warm milk for 5–10 minutes, or until foamy - Add eggs, sugar, vanilla extract and mix until well combined. - Add the flour and salt, then mix until a shaggy consistency  - Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface (or use a stand mixer) and knead for 10–20 minutes, adding 1 tbsp of softened butter at a time until fully incorporated. Continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - While the dough rises, make the raspberry jam by cooking the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice until thick. Add a cornstarch slurry if needed. Let cool. - Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, heavy cream, vanilla, salt, and a dollop of raspberry jam until fluffy. Refrigerate both fillings while the dough rises, then let them sit at room temperature before filling. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place the dough balls on a parchment-lined baking tray, leaving space between each. - Cover loosely and let rise for 30–40 minutes, or until puffy. When gently poked, the dough should slowly spring back, leaving a slight indentation. - In a large skillet heat oil to 315–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry the donuts, flipping every 30–45 seconds, until evenly golden brown and cooked through (about 2–3 minutes total). - Transfer the donuts to a wire rack to drain for 1–2 minutes. - Mix the freeze-dried raspberry powder with the sugar, then coat the warm donuts. - Poke a hole in each donut, then pipe in the raspberry jam followed by the cheesecake filling. • • • #baking #recipes #recipeideas #bakingideas #donuts

🥩 Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket 🍖 This Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket is slow-cooked until irresistibly tender, then finished with a rich, sticky barbecue glaze that caramelizes beautifully in the oven. Every slice is juicy, smoky, and packed with bold flavor, making it the perfect centerpiece for family dinners, weekend gatherings, or holiday meals. Ingredients For the Brisket • 4–5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp garlic powder • 2 tsp onion powder • 1½ tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chili powder • ½ tsp ground cumin For the Roasting Base • 1 large onion, sliced • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup beef broth • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce For the BBQ Glaze • 1½ cups barbecue sauce, divided • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Arrange the sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a large roasting pan or Dutch oven. 2. Pat the brisket dry with paper towels, then rub it all over with olive oil. 3. In a small bowl, combine the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, chili powder, and cumin. Rub the seasoning mixture evenly over every side of the brisket. 4. Place the brisket fat-side up on top of the onions. Pour the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce around the meat. 5. Cover the pan tightly with a lid or heavy-duty aluminum foil and roast for 4½–5 hours, or until the brisket is fork-tender. 6. In a bowl, whisk together 1 cup of the barbecue sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar. 7. Remove the brisket from the oven and generously brush the top with the barbecue glaze. 8. Increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C). Return the brisket to the oven uncovered and roast for another 10–15 minutes, until the glaze becomes glossy, caramelized, and slightly charred around the edges. 9. Transfer the brisket to a cutting board and let it rest for 20 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. 10. Drizzle the sliced brisket with the flavorful pan juices and serve with the remaining barbecue sauce. Serving Suggestions Serve with creamy mashed potatoes, baked beans, buttery cornbread, roasted corn on the cob, coleslaw, mac and cheese, or grilled vegetables for a classic Southern-style barbecue feast. Storage Store leftover brisket in an airtight container with a little extra barbecue sauce in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat gently in the oven or on the stovetop to keep the meat tender and juicy. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil.
